independence: The independent observer may publish the measured observation and verdict when assigned by trusted ingress. Candidate-authored summaries, fixture-role release decisions and real principal actions are separate; the observer never approves the real commitment.
observable: The submitted Purser Git candidate explains current evidence needed to close work in a fresh local CLI, then explains why the root still needs its principal.

outcomes.fail: Available complete evidence contradicts a required assertion.
outcomes.inconclusive: A missing input, unresolvable identity or unavailable observation prevents the assertion being tested.
outcomes.pass: Every required assertion is witnessed and retained.

required_assertions: Identify B independently with git cat-file and the checked-out commit. Check that archived A and B commit objects differ. Pin every command, artifact digest and complete log revision observed.

At the missing checkpoint, fresh python -B -m purser status/why at a fixed UTC time show child B from q02, the subject/version of its unsatisfied obligation from q07 and missing_evidence from both q08 and the child why. The child remains open for closure.

After the genuine late A observation/verdict and a close attempt, the exact B child remains unclosed, with the current obligation still missing. Verify the A/B association in admitted work/run facts and the attempted close disposition against the archived proposal/receipt or public decision. Another generation or revision alone does not establish this case.

After valid independently produced B evidence, the child closes. Fresh CLI why and q08 explain awaiting_acceptance on the still-unclosed root. q09 includes that outstanding commitment requirement and q10 identifies principal_accept. No real root answer is part of this test.

Stop the fixture worker, use new CLI processes without model credentials or service access, and compare the fixed-revision/fixed-time status and why responses before and after public replay in a disposable copy. All supported q01, q02, q07, q08, q09 and q10 answers must be reproducible.

Distinguish worker claims from independent evidence. Inspect readable submitted/candidate, observation and artifact references for the exact work, generation, run, criterion version, producer and verifier. Independently hash retained evidence bytes.
